next_action.rationale: A second, correctly-scoped apply_slot_correction (targeting carrier partition 2 per C8) was approved and applied this incident, but no outcome evidence for it has been ingested yet and the mission remains in the CORRECTING phase. Before writing a final assessment, we need to verify whether the correction actually reduced the stranded-order count, since a root-cause claim and an approved mitigation are not the same as confirmed remediation. count_stranded_orders is an allowed, read-only diagnostic that gives an authoritative current count (as opposed to the earlier proxy support-ticket counts), which both verifies mitigation effectiveness and supplies the impact_estimate artifact still missing from the checklist.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Confirms whether the EXC-0921 cohort is clearing after the corrected mitigation (supporting the root-cause claim and closing the incident) or is still stuck (indicating the correction needs further action or the mechanism needs revisiting), and provides an authoritative impact figure rather than a proxy.
